name: Grok
freeTierNote: Limited Chat, Imagine, and Grok Build.
bestFor: People who already pay for X and want a more current, informal assistant
skipIf: You need a vendor with boring enterprise procurement
limitations: Social-grounded answers are leads, not verified citations
Weak enterprise procurement and compliance story
summary: xAI’s assistant, wired into X. Useful for recent social context. A weak reason to rebuild a whole workflow.
body: Grok’s distribution is X, which is either a feature or a deal-breaker. It is quicker to talk about current events than a model that was trained last spring. It is not the coding or compliance pick. Paid Plus tiers are bundled through X subscriptions ($8/mo monthly or ~$7/mo annual). If you are not already on X, start with Claude or ChatGPT instead of adding a social network to your tool stack.
notes: Treat social-grounded answers as leads, not citations
Enterprise buyers should wait for a cleaner contract surface
Do not confuse Grok with GitHub Copilot or Microsoft Copilot
